name: mycrew-product
description: Layer 5/5 of the mycrew harness — the product plane, and the only layer that talks to the human about direction. /product-init founds the product repository (the folder holding your sub-project repos becomes its own git repo, with a North Star drawn from you). /setup then runs an endless interview that draws the whole product out of you and files each affirmed piece where it lives: features (docs/features/), architecture, specs — one plane for every sub-project. Strictly extractive: your vision, never its own. Drives mycrew-chief.
